name: Liam Walker
bio:
Liam's path to motorsports was somewhat unconventional, starting not in the garage but in the classroom, earning a degree in Supply Chain Management. However, his passion for racing, ignited by watching Bathurst as a kid, never waned. He combined his academic knowledge with his love for speed, landing an internship at a local V8 Supercars team before transitioning to Ferrari AF Corse three years ago. Liam thrives in the organized chaos of the paddock, meticulously planning every detail to ensure the smooth flow of equipment and personnel. His approach is proactive; he anticipates potential bottlenecks and develops contingency plans, earning him a reputation as a reliable and resourceful member of the team.

What sets Liam apart is his blend of meticulous planning and calm demeanor under pressure. He's known for keeping his cool when others are panicking, quickly finding solutions to logistical challenges that could derail a race weekend. He’s also a perfectionist, sometimes to a fault, but his dedication ensures that nothing is overlooked, and everything is in its place, contributing to the team's peak performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed hair with a slight wave.
physical.description: Liam is of average height with a lean build, reflecting his active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool, even in meetings.
Obsessively organizes his workspace, often color-coding items.
Has a specific brand of coffee he insists on having available at all times.
